title: Close Real Ontology Coverage Gaps

diagnosis_breakdown.note: ICD-10 via authoritative SNOMED->ICD-10-CM MRMAP; ICD-9 via shared-CUI + ICD-9->ICD-10(CUI)->SNOMED bridge.

methods_used: UMLS MRMAP SNOMEDCT_US->ICD-10-CM (TOTYPE=SDUI, excl REL=XR) inverted to ICD-10->SNOMED
ICD-9->ICD-10 via shared UMLS CUI (MRCONSO synonymy) then ICD-10->SNOMED via MRMAP
RxNorm IN/PIN ingredient index + conservative longest-span matching with electrolyte-fragment guard
anti_inflation_safeguards: No ICD title-string matches counted as SNOMED mappings.
No fuzzy string similarity used; only authoritative UMLS CUI/MRMAP links.
Bare INSULIN and DEXTROSE left UNMAPPED (ambiguous; no clean RxNorm ingredient).
Single-word electrolyte fragments (SODIUM, CHLORIDE...) never matched alone.

residual.diagnosis: Dominated by remaining ICD-9 disease codes (no SNOMED CUI / no bridgeable ICD-10) + V/Z status-history + E/V-Y external-cause codes (no SNOMED disease concept).
residual.medication: Dominated by IV fluids/electrolytes, vaccines/biologics, brand/combo strings, and correctly-skipped ambiguous INSULIN.

next_step: Phase 2 closed (Status A). Proceed to Phase 1b: implement ontology-backed anomaly-v2 injectors using the real engine + maps.
